description: This file defines the Renderer class, a base class for vector rendering in the Leaflet mapping library, handling DOM container, bounds, zoom animations, and interactions with map layers.

classes.name: Renderer
classes.description: A base class for vector renderers (SVG, Canvas) in Leaflet, managing container, bounds, zoom, and layer interactions.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with options, sets up layers.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Handles adding the renderer to the map, initializing container, and setting up event listeners.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Handles removal of the renderer from the map and cleans up event listeners.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Returns the event handlers for map interactions like zoom, move, and view reset.

methods.name: _updateTransform
methods.description: Calculates and applies CSS transform for zooming and panning.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the renderer's view and layers.

methods.name: _onZoomEnd
methods.description: Finalizes layer projection after zoom ends.

methods.name: _update
methods.description: Updates renderer bounds, center, and zoom based on map state.
